preamble: Clean, quiet game-interface texture art for a fantasy grand-strategy game, painted but restrained: matte surfaces, very fine and low-contrast material texture visible only at close view, flat even diffuse light, every plate lit uniformly from edge to edge with no vignette, no gradient, no glare, no darker or lighter corners, no wear marks, no stains. Small controls of blackened iron (#282B2C) with thin muted-bronze rims (#CAB289); gilt (#EBCA80) only where named.
tail: No cast shadows outside the plates, no text, no letters, no numbers, no runes, no figures, no faces, no animal heads, no crosses, no sun discs, no skulls, no crowns, no modern objects. No signature or maker's mark. The corners and the bottom edge of the image hold only the plain black ground.
layoutNote: Each item is one isolated object of about the same size, centred in its own cell, with wide black gutters between items, flat front view. Where a row names the same control in several states, the objects are identical in shape and size and differ only as described.
